name: ai4science-skills
description: Community index of Claude skills for scientific work. Every entry is pinned to an exact commit and checked automatically.

plugins.name: szl-evidence-skills
plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev as an optional, fail-closed second reader for evidence triage; decisions that carry their own evidence.
hosted_services: api.typesafe.ai - szl-typesafe-ai only, optional; sends the state you pass it; requires your own TypeSafe key
docs.typesafe.ai - linked documentation; visiting fetches documentation, not benchmark input
console.typesafe.ai - linked credential console; user-controlled credential setup

plugins.name: szl-science-skills
plugins.description: Integrated living research anatomy, scientific checks and reproducibility capsules; explicit prerelease, offline by default.
hosted_services: huggingface.co - optional explicit fetch-triage downloads four pinned public synthetic-study files and records byte hashes; public artifact CDN redirects may occur; no credentials or private data sent. Normal init/run/check is offline.

plugins.name: szl-frontier-flotation
plugins.description: MODELED flotation rank and abstaining unitless selectivity prior before the bench. Never recovery. No hosted service.

plugins.name: szl-science-multiplicity-skills
plugins.description: Complete-family Holm/BH multiplicity audit. HOLD if any planned result is missing. Offline; no hosted service.
hosted_services: doi.org - linked citations in the method contract; visiting fetches bibliographic records, not plan or results bytes
rss.onlinelibrary.wiley.com - linked Holm 1979 paper; visiting fetches publisher HTML, not plan or results bytes
www.jstor.org - linked Benjamini-Hochberg 1995 paper; visiting fetches publisher HTML, not plan or results bytes

plugins.name: szl-science-assay-skills
plugins.description: Offline assay-run audit for a declared increasing linear calibration, blank, QC and sample uncertainty. Synthetic fixtures; not method validation.
hosted_services: eurachem.org - linked measurement-uncertainty guidance; visiting fetches literature, not plate bytes
www.nist.gov - linked metrology notes; visiting fetches literature, not plate bytes

plugins.name: szl-science-replay-skills
plugins.description: Offline CSV column-mean replay against a frozen reference. MATCH, divergence, or incomplete. No network.

plugins.name: szl-paper-evidence-skills
plugins.description: Offline PDF table/figure locator against pinned original and extracted bytes. Human visual review required.
hosted_services: docling-project.github.io - linked local converter documentation; visiting fetches docs, not paper bytes

plugins.name: szl-science-ledger-skills
plugins.description: Sixteen offline evidence-ledger science skills from szl-skills@7c9086e1. Completes the v0.5.0-rc.1 family beside the eight-skill v0.2.0-rc.1 workbench pin.
hosted_services: journals.plos.org - clustered-replication literature link; visiting fetches HTML, not study bytes
pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov - clustered-replication literature link; visiting fetches HTML, not study bytes
example.invalid - fixture hostname in the refutation ledger; no network request is made
